CalibrationProfile.title: CalibrationProfile
CalibrationProfile.description: Device-tagged eye-tracking regression profile from the 5-point fit (optionally checked on 4 held-out points) owned by an authenticated user. The stored document does not record whether held-out validation ran, so clients must treat cloud profiles as not held-out validated.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner (must match request.auth.uid).

deviceModel.description: Android Build.MODEL identifier for camera geometry matching (1 to 80 chars).

matrixCoeffs.description: Exactly 12 numbers: flattened 2x6 regularized least-squares regression matrix mapping standardized [1, gx, gy, yaw, pitch, roll+distance] to normalized screen (x, y). Every element must be a number.

baselineEyeDistancePx.description: Reference inter-ocular pixel distance measured during calibration.

meanErrorMm.description: Approximate mean Euclidean error in millimeters reported by the calibration wizard: held-out 4-point validation error when validation ran, otherwise the in-sample residual of the 5-point fit (optimistic, not a validation result).

meanErrorPct.description: Mean Euclidean error as percentage of screen: held-out 4-point validation error when validation ran, otherwise the in-sample residual of the 5-point fit (optimistic, not a validation result).

maxErrorPct.description: Worst-point error as percentage of screen: worst held-out quadrant when validation ran, otherwise the worst 5-point fit target (in-sample, not a validation result).

closeBlinkThreshold.description: Lower Schmitt-trigger eye-open probability threshold for blink start. Must be at least 0.05 below openBlinkThreshold.

openBlinkThreshold.description: Upper Schmitt-trigger eye-open probability threshold for blink end. Must be >= closeBlinkThreshold + 0.05.

intentionalBlinkMinMs.description: Minimum eye closure duration in milliseconds for an intentional command blink (default 350 ms). Command blinks are intentionalBlinkMinMs to 800 ms, natural blinks 80 ms to intentionalBlinkMinMs - 1, so the value must stay below 800 ms; the rules cap it at 700 ms.

isActive.description: Whether this profile is the active one. Activation is exclusive: the client deactivates every other profile in the same batched write.

heldOutValidated.description: Optional. True only when the error metrics come from the 4 held-out validation targets; false (or absent, in records saved before the field existed) means they are the in-sample fit residual. Set on create only; the rules reject changing it later.

calibrationPosture.description: Optional. GazePostureProfile the fit was recorded in (absent reads as UPRIGHT). Set on create only; the rules reject changing it later.

createdAt.description: Firestore Timestamp value (not a string field), written as FieldValue.serverTimestamp(); the rules require createdAt == request.time on create and an unchanged value on update.

updatedAt.description: Firestore Timestamp value (not a string field), written as FieldValue.serverTimestamp(); the rules require updatedAt == request.time on every create and update.

TrackingSession.title: TrackingSession
TrackingSession.description: Recorded section-level screen attention and blink telemetry session owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner (must match request.auth.uid).

title.description: Title of the reading passage or control deck session (1 to 120 chars).

naturalBlinkCount.description: Count of natural involuntary blinks (80 ms to intentionalBlinkMinMs - 1; default 80-349 ms).

intentionalBlinkCount.description: Count of intentional command blinks (intentionalBlinkMinMs to 800 ms; default 350-800 ms). Longer closures are rests, not commands.

effectiveWordsPerMinute.description: Client-side reading-speed estimate in words per minute derived from session timing and section dwell, not from word-level gaze tracking. 0 means no estimate.

fixationClusterCount.description: Count of dispersion-grouped coarse fixation centroids.

topZonePercentage.description: Percentage of active gaze time in top screen third (0-100).

middleZonePercentage.description: Percentage of active gaze time in middle screen third (0-100).

bottomZonePercentage.description: Percentage of active gaze time in bottom screen third (0-100).

sectionLoads.description: Bounded list (max 12) of section dwell summary strings (e.g. 'sec_1:Intro:42'). Every element must be a string of at most 120 chars and must not contain U+001F.

clusterPoints.description: Bounded list (max 40) of coarse fixation cluster strings encoded as 'x,y,dwellMs'. Every element must be a string of at most 80 chars and must not contain U+001F.

createdAt.description: Firestore Timestamp value (not a string field), written as FieldValue.serverTimestamp(); the rules require createdAt == request.time on create and an unchanged value on update.

updatedAt.description: Firestore Timestamp value (not a string field), written as FieldValue.serverTimestamp(); the rules require updatedAt == request.time on every create and update.

/users/{userId}/calibrations/{profileId}.description: User-scoped calibration profiles containing standardized 2x6 regression matrices and the wizard's error metrics (held-out when validation ran, otherwise in-sample fit residuals; the document does not say which).

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: User-scoped eye tracking and section attention analytics sessions.
